title: Preserve conversation context, sanitize unclosed tool calls, and persist steer in SQLite
commitMessage: fix(agent): preserve conversation context and sanitize tool calls on steer
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Fixed critical steer agent context loss and tool-call schema violations: (1) Preserved conversation continuity in run_agent_loop by adopting existing in-memory context (AppState::agent_contexts) when messages > 2 instead of wiping with a fresh 2-message array; (2) Added SQLite dialogue fallback reconstruction (reconstruct_messages_from_dialog) to recover full conversation history including user steer directives, tool calls, and assistant outputs after app restarts; (3) Prevented run_agent from overwriting state.agent_contexts by using entry.or_insert_with instead of unconditional insertion; (4) Added persistent SQLite logging for steer directives via append_task_dialog_activity ('type': 'steer') in steer_agent and run_agent_loop; (5) Implemented sanitize_unclosed_tool_calls to append synthetic tool responses ('[Инструмент прерван указанием пользователя]') for unclosed assistant tool_calls caused by aborts mid-execution, preventing LLM API 400 Bad Request errors; (6) Added sync_context_state on all abort/break checkpoints; (7) Formulated Section 2.31 invariant in AGENTS.md; (8) Added 3 comprehensive Rust unit tests covering sanitization, dialog reconstruction, and SQLite persistence.

rootCauses.cause: run_agent_loop unconditionally overwrote in-memory context state with only a 2-message array on steer
rootCauses.detail: At the start of run_agent_loop, messages was initialized to vec![ChatMessage::system(...), ChatMessage::user(...)], completely discarding turns 1..N of dialogue and intermediate tool executions.
rootCauses.resolution: Inspect AppState::agent_contexts first for existing messages (>2); adopt existing turn and message history, or reconstruct from SQLite dialog items if absent.

rootCauses.detail: In run_agent, ctx_map.insert(task_id, AgentContextState::default()) clobbered pre-existing conversation context whenever run_agent was re-invoked on steer.
steer_agent emitted IPC events and pushed to in-memory context but never appended a dialog item to SQLite, causing the steer card to vanish on task reload or application restart.
rootCauses.resolution: Added append_task_dialog_activity with type 'steer' to both steer_agent and run_agent_loop.

rootCauses.cause: Aborting mid-tool execution left unclosed assistant tool_calls without tool responses
rootCauses.detail: When an agent loop aborted while executing a tool, the assistant message declaring tool_calls lacked corresponding role: 'tool' responses, triggering HTTP 400 Bad Request on the next LLM call.
rootCauses.resolution: Implemented sanitize_unclosed_tool_calls to detect missing tool responses and synthesize interruption placeholder messages.
